posts.text: Really appreciate this post. Yes AI is progressing very fast, but we still have the tools to describe what is happening without jumping to conclusions.
posts.quoted: Recursive self-improvement is a critical issue, but the rhetoric on the subject is becoming more poorly calibrated over time. As we approach new stages of AI development—and RSI is one of them—we need more precise frameworks and terminology. I fear the opposite is happening.
